12.t: Working with data: where scientists work
q: Where do most of these scientists work?
How many scientists work outdoors or in a hospital?
What fraction of the scientists work in a laboratory? Give your answer as a percentage.
A poster says "all scientists work in labs". Use the data to explain why this is wrong, and suggest one way to make the survey more reliable.

Only 35% work mainly in a lab; 78 of 120 work outdoors, at a computer, in hospitals or factories. Ask more scientists from many countries and sciences, so the sample is larger and more representative.
